_comment: A vent on the floor of an abyss -- see `DeepSeaVent` for the shape and for why each part of it is
there. Shipped as a configured feature so it has an id, which is what `/place feature` and the D'ni
city can name it by. **There is deliberately no placed feature of the same name**: every placed feature
is a word a writer can say, and a vent must not be sayable -- it is earned by an abyss and a deluge
(`EarlyGameRareMaterials.ventsTheAbyss`), which lays it through a placement held in code.
